What terma's OpenCode plugin (scope `terma-opencode` version 2) posted to the relay, one
file per case: `requests` are the OTLP/JSON bodies in the order sent, `hooks` the
`terma hook` calls the plugin made. Captured 2026-11-25 on Linux with OpenCode 1.19.6
against a scripted OpenAI-compatible provider, with no account; paths scrubbed to
`/home/user`.
